title: Supervised Practicum I
description: An introduction to direct practice experience with children/youth in a supervised CYC setting. Acquire foundational professional skills, integrate knowledge obtained through coursework, develop a framework for ethical praxis and gain CYC practice experience.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CYC 211, CYC 210, CYC 210A.
Students in the Bachelor of Child and Youth Care program must earn a minimum grade of C+ in all pre- or co-requisites.
